# The static GNU runtime flags are required only for the MinGW distribution
# targets.  AppleClang and other native toolchains reject these options; keep
# the policy in one helper so contract/smoke targets remain portable.
function(arp_add_mingw_static_runtime target_name)
    if(MINGW)
        target_link_options(${target_name} PRIVATE
            -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc)
    endif()
endfunction()

# Declare a script plugin from its v2 manifest.  The manifest remains the
# source of truth for both developer DLLs and release/static builds; this
# helper only wires the CMake targets and emits the catalog adapter.
function(arp_add_script_plugin)
    set(options)
    set(oneValueArgs MANIFEST TARGET REFLECTION_OWNER)
    set(multiValueArgs LINK_LIBRARIES INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
    cmake_parse_arguments(ARP_PLUGIN "" "${oneValueArgs}" "${multiValueArgs}" ${ARGN})
    if(NOT ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "arp_add_script_plugin requires MANIFEST")
    endif()
    if(NOT EXISTS "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "script plugin manifest not found: ${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
    endif()
    file(STRINGS "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}" _arp_plugin_contract REGEX "^[ 	]*contractVersion:[ 	]*[0-9]+")
    if(NOT _arp_plugin_contract MATCHES "contractVersion:[ 	]*2")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "script plugin manifest must use contractVersion 2: ${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
    endif()
    file(STRINGS "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}" _arp_plugin_module REGEX "^[ 	]*module:[ 	]*[^#]+")
    file(STRINGS "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}" _arp_plugin_module_version REGEX "^[ 	]*moduleVersion:[ 	]*[0-9]+")
    file(STRINGS "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}" _arp_plugin_source REGEX "^[ 	]*source:[ 	]*[^#]+")
    file(STRINGS "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}" _arp_plugin_entry REGEX "^[ 	]*entry:[ 	]*[^#]+")
    file(STRINGS "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}" _arp_plugin_export_hash REGEX "^[ 	]*exportContractHash:[ 	]*[^#]+")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[ 	]*module:[ 	]*" "" _arp_plugin_module "${_arp_plugin_module}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[ 	]*moduleVersion:[ 	]*" "" _arp_plugin_module_version "${_arp_plugin_module_version}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[ 	]*source:[ 	]*" "" _arp_plugin_source "${_arp_plugin_source}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[ 	]*entry:[ 	]*" "" _arp_plugin_entry "${_arp_plugin_entry}")
    string(REGEX REPLACE "^[ 	]*exportContractHash:[ 	]*" "" _arp_plugin_export_hash "${_arp_plugin_export_hash}")
    string(STRIP "${_arp_plugin_module}" _arp_plugin_module)
    string(STRIP "${_arp_plugin_module_version}" _arp_plugin_module_version)
    string(STRIP "${_arp_plugin_source}" _arp_plugin_source)
    string(STRIP "${_arp_plugin_entry}" _arp_plugin_entry)
    string(STRIP "${_arp_plugin_export_hash}" _arp_plugin_export_hash)
    if(NOT _arp_plugin_module OR NOT _arp_plugin_module_version
       OR NOT _arp_plugin_source OR NOT _arp_plugin_entry
       OR NOT _arp_plugin_export_hash)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "v2 script plugin manifest requires module/moduleVersion/source/entry/exportContractHash: ${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
    endif()
    if(NOT _arp_plugin_module_version MATCHES "^[1-9][0-9]*$")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "script plugin moduleVersion must be a positive integer: ${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
    endif()
    get_filename_component(_arp_plugin_manifest_dir "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}" DIRECTORY)
    file(READ "${_arp_plugin_manifest_dir}/${_arp_plugin_source}" _arp_plugin_source_text)
    # Domain plugin entries may only invoke generated reflection registration
    # and explicitly named service-backed callables. Any ordinary export or
    # hand-written reflection is a contract violation.
    if(_arp_plugin_source_text MATCHES
        "registration::class_|bindType<|bindClass<|exportValue[ 	]*\\(|exportFunction[ 	]*\\(|exportCallable[ 	]*\\(")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "script plugin entry must use generated reflection; manual export/reflection found: ${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
    endif()
    if(NOT _arp_plugin_module MATCHES "^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "script plugin module must be a flat identifier (dots are not supported): ${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
    endif()
    if(NOT ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET)
        set(ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET "arp_script_plugin_${_arp_plugin_module}")
    endif()
    string(REGEX REPLACE "[^A-Za-z0-9_]" "_" _arp_plugin_symbol "${_arp_plugin_module}")
    file(STRINGS "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}" _arp_plugin_manifest_lines)
    set(_arp_plugin_in_reflection_headers FALSE)
    set(_arp_plugin_reflection_headers)
    foreach(_arp_plugin_line IN LISTS _arp_plugin_manifest_lines)
        string(STRIP "${_arp_plugin_line}" _arp_plugin_trimmed)
        if(_arp_plugin_trimmed STREQUAL "reflectionHeaders:")
            set(_arp_plugin_in_reflection_headers TRUE)
        elseif(_arp_plugin_in_reflection_headers)
            if(_arp_plugin_trimmed MATCHES "^-[ 	]*(.+)$")
                string(REGEX REPLACE "^-[ 	]*" "" _arp_plugin_header "${_arp_plugin_trimmed}")
                string(STRIP "${_arp_plugin_header}" _arp_plugin_header)
                if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${_arp_plugin_header}")
                    list(APPEND _arp_plugin_reflection_headers "${_arp_plugin_header}")
                elseif(_arp_plugin_header MATCHES "^src[/\\]")
                    list(APPEND _arp_plugin_reflection_headers
                        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_arp_plugin_header}")
                else()
                    list(APPEND _arp_plugin_reflection_headers
                        "${_arp_plugin_manifest_dir}/${_arp_plugin_header}")
                endif()
            elseif(_arp_plugin_trimmed MATCHES "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*:")
                set(_arp_plugin_in_reflection_headers FALSE)
            endif()
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(NOT _arp_plugin_reflection_headers)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "v2 script plugin manifest requires reflectionHeaders: ${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
    endif()
    # Service adapters may live beside a reflection header rather than beside
    # the tiny ABI entry translation unit. Audit those paired implementations
    # as well so manual static exports cannot bypass the codegen-only gate.
    set(_arp_plugin_generated_registration_found FALSE)
    if(_arp_plugin_source_text MATCHES
        "reflection::generated::register_${_arp_plugin_module}_reflection[ \\t]*\\(")
        set(_arp_plugin_generated_registration_found TRUE)
    endif()
    foreach(_arp_plugin_header IN LISTS _arp_plugin_reflection_headers)
        get_filename_component(_arp_plugin_header_ext
            "${_arp_plugin_header}" EXT)
        if(_arp_plugin_header_ext STREQUAL ".h")
            get_filename_component(_arp_plugin_header_stem
                "${_arp_plugin_header}" NAME_WE)
            get_filename_component(_arp_plugin_header_dir
                "${_arp_plugin_header}" DIRECTORY)
            set(_arp_plugin_paired_cpp
                "${_arp_plugin_header_dir}/${_arp_plugin_header_stem}.cpp")
            if(EXISTS "${_arp_plugin_paired_cpp}")
                file(READ "${_arp_plugin_paired_cpp}" _arp_plugin_paired_text)
                if(_arp_plugin_paired_text MATCHES
                    "reflection::generated::register_${_arp_plugin_module}_reflection[ \\t]*\\(")
                    set(_arp_plugin_generated_registration_found TRUE)
                endif()
                if(_arp_plugin_paired_text MATCHES
                    "registration::class_|bindType<|bindClass<|exportValue[ \\t]*\\(|exportFunction[ \\t]*\\(|exportCallable[ \\t]*\\(")
                    message(FATAL_ERROR
                        "script plugin implementation must use generated reflection; manual export/reflection found: ${_arp_plugin_paired_cpp}")
                endif()
            endif()
        endif()
    endforeach()
    if(NOT _arp_plugin_generated_registration_found)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "script plugin must call generated registration register_${_arp_plugin_module}_reflection(): ${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}")
    endif()
    set(_arp_plugin_link_libraries ${ARP_PLUGIN_LINK_LIBRARIES})
    if(ARP_SCRIPT_AOT_ONLY_RELEASE)
        list(REMOVE_ITEM _arp_plugin_link_libraries
            arp_scriptvm_runtime arp_scriptvm_ir arp_scriptvm_frontend arp_scriptvm_interpreter
            arp_scriptvm_aot_tooling)
        list(APPEND _arp_plugin_link_libraries
            arp_scriptvm_host_plugin_runtime)
    endif()
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
        add_library(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET} STATIC "${_arp_plugin_manifest_dir}/${_arp_plugin_source}")
    else()
        add_library(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET} MODULE "${_arp_plugin_manifest_dir}/${_arp_plugin_source}")
    endif()
    target_include_directories(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET} PRIVATE . src "${_arp_plugin_manifest_dir}" ${ARP_PLUGIN_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
    target_link_libraries(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET} PRIVATE ${_arp_plugin_link_libraries})
    set_target_properties(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET} PROPERTIES PREFIX "" OUTPUT_NAME "${_arp_plugin_module}")
    if(ARP_SCRIPT_AOT_ONLY_RELEASE AND CMAKE_NM)
        add_custom_command(TARGET ${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
                -DNM_EXECUTABLE=${CMAKE_NM}
                -DARTIFACT=$<TARGET_FILE:${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}>
                -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/VerifyScriptAotOnlySymbols.cmake"
            VERBATIM)
    endif()

    set(_arp_reflection_dir
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/reflection/${_arp_plugin_module}")
    set(_arp_reflection_cpp
        "${_arp_reflection_dir}/${_arp_plugin_module}.reflection.gen.cpp")
    set(_arp_reflection_json
        "${_arp_reflection_dir}/${_arp_plugin_module}.reflection.json")
    if(ARP_PLUGIN_REFLECTION_OWNER)
        set(_arp_reflection_target "${ARP_PLUGIN_REFLECTION_OWNER}")
    else()
        set(_arp_reflection_target "${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}")
    endif()
    arp_reflection_generate(
        TARGET ${_arp_reflection_target}
        MODULE ${_arp_plugin_module}
        OUT_CPP "${_arp_reflection_cpp}"
        OUT_JSON "${_arp_reflection_json}"
        MANIFEST "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}"
        HEADERS ${_arp_plugin_reflection_headers})
    if(ARP_PLUGIN_REFLECTION_OWNER)
        add_dependencies(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}
            "${_arp_reflection_target}_${_arp_plugin_module}_reflection_generated")
    endif()

    set(_arp_catalog_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/arp_script_plugins")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_arp_catalog_dir}")
    # Older configurations emitted dotted compatibility catalog names (for
    # example arp.core.cpp). They are generated build artifacts, not valid v2
    # modules; remove them when reusing an existing build tree so historical
    # files cannot satisfy or poison the current catalog audit.
    file(GLOB _arp_historical_catalogs
        "${_arp_catalog_dir}/*.cpp")
    foreach(_arp_historical_catalog IN LISTS _arp_historical_catalogs)
        get_filename_component(_arp_historical_name
            "${_arp_historical_catalog}" NAME_WE)
        if(_arp_historical_name MATCHES "\\.")
            file(REMOVE "${_arp_historical_catalog}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    set(_arp_catalog_cpp "${_arp_catalog_dir}/${_arp_plugin_module}.cpp")
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${_arp_catalog_cpp}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
            "-DARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST=${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}"
            "-DARP_PLUGIN_REFLECTION_JSON=${_arp_reflection_json}"
            "-DARP_PLUGIN_OUTPUT=${_arp_catalog_cpp}"
            -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/GenerateScriptPluginCatalog.cmake"
        DEPENDS
            "${ARP_PLUGIN_MANIFEST}"
            "${_arp_reflection_json}"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/GenerateScriptPluginCatalog.cmake"
        VERBATIM)
    add_library(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}_static OBJECT
        "${_arp_plugin_manifest_dir}/${_arp_plugin_source}"
        "${_arp_catalog_cpp}")
    if(NOT ARP_PLUGIN_REFLECTION_OWNER)
        target_sources(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}_static PRIVATE "${_arp_reflection_cpp}")
    endif()
    target_include_directories(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}_static PRIVATE
        . src "${_arp_plugin_manifest_dir}" ${ARP_PLUGIN_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
    target_link_libraries(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}_static PRIVATE ${_arp_plugin_link_libraries})
    if(MINGW)
        target_compile_options(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}_static PRIVATE "-Wa,-mbig-obj")
    endif()
    add_dependencies(${ARP_PLUGIN_TARGET}_static
        "${_arp_reflection_target}_${_arp_plugin_module}_reflection_generated")
endfunction()

# Bundle manifest verification is intentionally synchronous and hashes every
# staged file. Keep this security-critical loop optimized in Debug so a full
# validation remains a practical startup gate without changing the algorithm.
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
    set_source_files_properties(src/core/hash/sha256.cpp PROPERTIES
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-O2>")
endif()

add_executable(arp_graphics_shader_module_artifact_tests tests/contract/graphics_shader_module_artifact_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(arp_graphics_shader_module_artifact_tests PRIVATE arp_shader)
add_executable(arp_graphics_triangle_storage_proof_tests tests/contract/graphics_triangle_storage_proof_tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(arp_graphics_triangle_storage_proof_tests PRIVATE arp_shader)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(arp_graphics_triangle_storage_proof_tests PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
else()
    target_compile_options(arp_graphics_triangle_storage_proof_tests PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
endif()
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(arp_graphics_shader_module_artifact_tests PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
else()
    target_compile_options(arp_graphics_shader_module_artifact_tests PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
endif()
if(Python3_EXECUTABLE AND SLANGC_EXECUTABLE AND SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE
    AND NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
    set(graphics_module_fixture "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/graphics-module-fixture")
    set(graphics_module_publication "${graphics_module_fixture}/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.graphics.module.yaml")
    set(graphics_module_outputs "${graphics_module_publication}")
    foreach(role slang spv metal wgsl reflection.yaml)
        list(APPEND graphics_module_outputs "${graphics_module_fixture}/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.${role}")
        foreach(stage Vertex Fragment)
            list(APPEND graphics_module_outputs "${graphics_module_fixture}/${stage}/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.${role}")
        endforeach()
    endforeach()
    list(APPEND graphics_module_outputs
        "${graphics_module_fixture}/Vertex/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.vertexMain.entry.yaml"
        "${graphics_module_fixture}/Fragment/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.fragmentMain.entry.yaml")
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${graphics_module_outputs}
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
            --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            --fixture ordinary_graphics_storage_read --graphics-module --out-dir "${graphics_module_fixture}"
        DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py"
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.slang"
        VERBATIM)
    add_custom_target(arp_graphics_shader_module_fixture DEPENDS ${graphics_module_outputs})
    add_dependencies(arp_graphics_shader_module_artifact_tests arp_graphics_shader_module_fixture)
    add_dependencies(arp_graphics_triangle_storage_proof_tests arp_graphics_shader_module_fixture)
    add_test(NAME arp_graphics_triangle_storage_proof_tests COMMAND arp_graphics_triangle_storage_proof_tests
        "${graphics_module_fixture}/Vertex/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.spv"
        "${graphics_module_fixture}/Fragment/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.spv"
        "${graphics_module_fixture}/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.wgsl")
    add_test(NAME arp_graphics_shader_module_artifact_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/graphics_shader_module_artifact_test.py"
            --executable $<TARGET_FILE:arp_graphics_shader_module_artifact_tests> --publication "${graphics_module_publication}")
    add_executable(arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests tests/contract/single_entry_shader_artifact_tests.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests PRIVATE arp_shader)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
    else()
        target_compile_options(arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    endif()
    set(single_entry_publications)
    set(single_entry_test_args)
    foreach(entry_case vertexMain fragmentMain computeMain indirectProducer indirectNoopIndex indirectNoopInstance positiveBaseMain zeroInstanceBaseMain outOfRangeIndexMain outOfRangeInstanceMain shadowVertex scalarVertex scalarFragment uniformVertex uniformFragment uniformArrayVertex uniformArrayFragment pushVertex pushFragment storageVertex storageFragment storageArrayVertex storageArrayFragment writeVertex writeFragment readVertex readFragment uniformReadVertex uniformReadFragment streamVertex streamFragment)
        set(entry "${entry_case}")
        set(entry_source_args)
        set(entry_target_policy_args)
        if(entry_case STREQUAL "indirectProducer")
            set(entry computeMain)
            set(fixture ordinary_indirect_producer)
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^indirectNoop")
            set(fixture ordinary_indirect_noop)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "indirectNoopIndex")
                set(entry noopIndexMain)
            else()
                set(entry noopInstanceMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^(positiveBase|zeroInstanceBase|outOfRangeIndex|outOfRangeInstance)Main$")
            set(fixture ordinary_indirect_boundaries)
        elseif(entry_case STREQUAL "shadowVertex")
            set(entry vertexMain)
            set(fixture shadow_depth)
            set(entry_source_args --module "${fixture}")
            set(entry_source_dependency shaders/wocc/shadow_depth.slang)
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^scalar")
            set(fixture wocc_water_blend)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "scalarVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
            set(entry_source_args --module "${fixture}")
            set(entry_source_dependency shaders/wocc/water_blend.slang)
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^uniformRead")
            set(fixture ordinary_graphics_uniform_read)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "uniformReadVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^uniformArray")
            set(fixture ordinary_graphics_uniform_array)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "uniformArrayVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^uniform")
            set(fixture ordinary_graphics_uniform)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "uniformVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^stream")
            set(fixture vertex_stream_instancing)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "streamVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^storageArray")
            set(fixture ordinary_graphics_storage_array)
            set(entry_target_policy_args --wgsl-buffer-array-diagnostic)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "storageArrayVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^read")
            set(fixture ordinary_graphics_storage_read)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "readVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^write")
            set(fixture ordinary_graphics_storage_write)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "writeVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
                set(entry_target_policy_args --wgsl-graphics-atomic-diagnostic
                    --graphics-write-proof-tool $<TARGET_FILE:arp_fragment_atomic_write_verifier>)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^storage")
            set(fixture ordinary_graphics_storage)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "storageVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry_case MATCHES "^push")
            set(fixture ordinary_graphics_push)
            if(entry_case STREQUAL "pushVertex")
                set(entry vertexMain)
            else()
                set(entry fragmentMain)
            endif()
        elseif(entry STREQUAL "computeMain")
            set(fixture descriptor_compute)
        else()
            set(fixture descriptor_array)
        endif()
        if(NOT entry_source_args)
            set(entry_source_args --fixture "${fixture}")
            set(entry_source_dependency tests/fixtures/${fixture}.slang)
        endif()
        set(entry_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/${entry_case}")
        set(publication "${entry_dir}/${fixture}.${entry}.entry.yaml")
        set(entry_wgsl_byproduct "${entry_dir}/${fixture}.wgsl")
        if(entry_target_policy_args)
            set(entry_wgsl_byproduct)
        endif()
        set(entry_header_byproduct)
        if(entry_case STREQUAL "shadowVertex")
            set(entry_header_byproduct "${entry_dir}/${fixture}.shader_bindings.h")
        endif()
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${publication}"
            BYPRODUCTS "${entry_dir}/${fixture}.slang" "${entry_dir}/${fixture}.spv"
                "${entry_dir}/${fixture}.metal" ${entry_wgsl_byproduct} "${entry_dir}/${fixture}.reflection.yaml"
                ${entry_header_byproduct}
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
                ${entry_source_args} ${entry_target_policy_args} --single-entry "${entry}" --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}"
                --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}" --out-dir "${entry_dir}"
            DEPENDS ${entry_source_dependency} scripts/compile_shaders.py scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py scripts/spirv_layout.py arp_fragment_atomic_write_verifier
            VERBATIM)
        list(APPEND single_entry_publications "${publication}")
        if(NOT entry_case MATCHES "^scalar")
            list(APPEND single_entry_test_args --publication "${publication}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(arp_single_entry_shader_fixture DEPENDS ${single_entry_publications})
    add_dependencies(arp_fragment_atomic_write_proof_tests arp_single_entry_shader_fixture)
    add_dependencies(arp_compute_indirect_producer_proof_tests arp_single_entry_shader_fixture)
    add_dependencies(arp_vertex_location_input_proof_tests arp_single_entry_shader_fixture)
    add_test(NAME arp_vertex_location_input_proof_tests COMMAND arp_vertex_location_input_proof_tests
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/streamVertex/vertex_stream_instancing.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/storageVertex/ordinary_graphics_storage.spv")
    add_test(NAME arp_compute_indirect_producer_proof_tests COMMAND arp_compute_indirect_producer_proof_tests
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/indirectProducer/ordinary_indirect_producer.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/writeFragment/ordinary_graphics_storage_write.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/indirectNoopIndex/ordinary_indirect_noop.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/indirectNoopInstance/ordinary_indirect_noop.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/positiveBaseMain/ordinary_indirect_boundaries.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/zeroInstanceBaseMain/ordinary_indirect_boundaries.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/outOfRangeIndexMain/ordinary_indirect_boundaries.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/outOfRangeInstanceMain/ordinary_indirect_boundaries.spv")
    add_test(NAME arp_fragment_atomic_write_proof_tests COMMAND arp_fragment_atomic_write_proof_tests
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/writeFragment/ordinary_graphics_storage_write.spv")
    add_test(NAME arp_fragment_storage_read_proof_tests COMMAND arp_fragment_storage_read_proof_tests
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/readFragment/ordinary_graphics_storage_read.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/writeFragment/ordinary_graphics_storage_write.spv"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/uniformReadFragment/ordinary_graphics_uniform_read.spv")
    add_dependencies(arp_fragment_storage_read_proof_tests arp_single_entry_shader_fixture)
    add_dependencies(arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests arp_single_entry_shader_fixture)
    add_dependencies(arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests arp_spirv_buffer_declaration_layout_verifier)
    target_include_directories(arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/shadowVertex")
    add_test(NAME arp_spirv_matrix_layout_codegen_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/spirv_matrix_layout_codegen_tests.py"
            --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            --spv "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture/shadowVertex/shadow_depth.spv")
    add_test(NAME arp_shader_buffer_layout_facts_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/shader_buffer_layout_facts_test.py"
            --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            --fixtures "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/single-entry-fixture")
    set_tests_properties(arp_shader_buffer_layout_facts_tests PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "ARP_BUFFER_LAYOUT_VERIFIER=$<TARGET_FILE:arp_spirv_buffer_declaration_layout_verifier>;ARP_BUFFER_TYPE_LAYOUT_VERIFIER=$<TARGET_FILE:arp_buffer_declaration_type_layout_tests>")
    add_test(NAME arp_wgsl_buffer_array_diagnostic_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/wgsl_buffer_array_diagnostic_test.py"
            --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            --loader $<TARGET_FILE:arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests>)
    add_test(NAME arp_wgsl_graphics_atomic_diagnostic_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/wgsl_graphics_atomic_diagnostic_test.py"
            --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            --proof-tool $<TARGET_FILE:arp_fragment_atomic_write_verifier>
            --loader $<TARGET_FILE:arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests>)
    add_test(NAME arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/single_entry_shader_artifact_test.py"
            --executable $<TARGET_FILE:arp_single_entry_shader_artifact_tests> ${single_entry_test_args})
endif()

if(MINGW AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64|amd64)$")
    # Jolt's public definitions advertise SSE4.2, while ThirdParty.cmake
    # intentionally strips its PUBLIC CPU options to avoid affecting the
    # rest of the engine. Physics translation units still instantiate Jolt
    # inline query code and therefore require the matching private option.
    target_compile_options(arp_physics PRIVATE -msse4.2)
endif()

set(bindless_zero_base_identity "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/rhi/bindless_zero_base_identity.h")
set(bindless_zero_base_compiler_args)
set(bindless_zero_base_compiler_deps)
if(SLANGC_EXECUTABLE AND EXISTS "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}")
    list(APPEND bindless_zero_base_compiler_args --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}")
    list(APPEND bindless_zero_base_compiler_deps "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}")
    if(SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE AND EXISTS "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}")
        list(APPEND bindless_zero_base_compiler_args --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}")
        list(APPEND bindless_zero_base_compiler_deps "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}")
    else()
        get_filename_component(bindless_zero_base_tool_dir "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" DIRECTORY)
        get_filename_component(bindless_zero_base_tool_ext "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" LAST_EXT)
        set(bindless_zero_base_reflect "${bindless_zero_base_tool_dir}/spirv-reflect${bindless_zero_base_tool_ext}")
        if(EXISTS "${bindless_zero_base_reflect}")
            list(APPEND bindless_zero_base_compiler_deps "${bindless_zero_base_reflect}")
        endif()
    endif()
endif()
add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${bindless_zero_base_identity}"
    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/bindless_zero_base_identity.py"
        --output "${bindless_zero_base_identity}"
        ${bindless_zero_base_compiler_args}
    DEPENDS scripts/bindless_zero_base_identity.py scripts/bindless_codegen.py scripts/buffer_vector_record.py scripts/slang_resource_switch.py
        scripts/compile_shaders.py scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py scripts/spirv_layout.py
        scripts/gpu_visibility_codegen.py shaders/renderer/gpu_visibility.bindless.yaml
        shaders/renderer/gpu_visibility_bindless.slang shaders/core/gpu_visibility_kernel.slang
        shaders/renderer/gpu_visibility_consumer.bindless.yaml shaders/renderer/gpu_visibility_consumer.slang
        shaders/core/gpu_visibility.slang shaders/core/instance_transform.slang
        ${bindless_zero_base_compiler_deps}
    VERBATIM)
target_sources(arp_rhi PRIVATE "${bindless_zero_base_identity}")
target_include_directories(arp_rhi PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/rhi")
target_link_libraries(arp_rhi PUBLIC arp_core arp_shader arp_reflection)
if(MINGW)
    # RHI ownership contracts instantiate more than COFF's small-object section
    # limit with GCC 16 Debug. Consumers instantiate the same public templates.
    target_compile_options(arp_rhi PUBLIC "-Wa,-mbig-obj")
endif()

if(NOT APPLE AND NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
    target_sources(arp_platform PRIVATE src/platform/native/render_system_vulkan.cpp)
    if(WIN32)
        target_sources(arp_platform PRIVATE src/platform/windows/window_win32.cpp)
        # vulkan/vulkan.h (with VK_USE_PLATFORM_WIN32_KHR) for the Win32
        # surface path in window_win32.cpp.
        target_link_libraries(arp_platform PUBLIC arp_vulkan_headers gdi32)
    else()
        target_sources(arp_platform PRIVATE src/platform/linux/window_xcb.cpp)
        find_package(X11 QUIET)
        find_path(XCB_INCLUDE_DIR xcb/xcb.h)
        find_library(XCB_LIBRARY NAMES xcb)
        find_library(XKBCOMMON_LIBRARY NAMES xkbcommon)
        find_library(XKBCOMMON_X11_LIBRARY NAMES xkbcommon-x11)
        if(NOT XCB_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT XCB_LIBRARY OR NOT XKBCOMMON_LIBRARY
            OR NOT XKBCOMMON_X11_LIBRARY)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Linux window support requires libxcb and libxkbcommon development packages")
        endif()
        target_include_directories(arp_platform PUBLIC ${XCB_INCLUDE_DIR})
        target_link_libraries(arp_platform PUBLIC ${XCB_LIBRARY} ${XKBCOMMON_LIBRARY} ${XKBCOMMON_X11_LIBRARY} ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
    endif()
endif()
if(APPLE)
    target_sources(arp_platform PRIVATE src/platform/native/render_system_native_shared.cpp src/platform/native/render_system_metal.cpp)
    if(NOT IOS)
        target_sources(arp_platform PRIVATE src/platform/macos/window_cocoa.mm)
        target_link_libraries(arp_platform PUBLIC "-framework AppKit")
    endif()
endif()

# WebGPU capability/ownership contracts are kept as first-class build targets.
# The device contract is a native-host contract in desktop builds; the
# browser fixture builds the Emscripten variant separately with its own
# bootstrap pre-js and canvas harness.
# Domain script plugins share v2 manifests between development DLLs and the
# static object/catalog path. Web builds consume the static objects only.
arp_add_script_plugin(
    MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/arp.core_module.arpplugin"
    TARGET arp_script_plugin_core
    LINK_LIBRARIES arp_scriptvm_runtime arp_scriptvm_ir arp_scriptvm_frontend arp_scriptvm_interpreter arp_scriptvm_aot_tooling)
arp_add_script_plugin(
    MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/arp.scene_module.arpplugin"
    TARGET arp_script_plugin_scene
    LINK_LIBRARIES arp_scriptvm_runtime arp_scriptvm_ir arp_scriptvm_frontend arp_scriptvm_interpreter arp_scriptvm_aot_tooling arp_scene arp_2d)
arp_add_script_plugin(
    MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/arp.scene3d_module.arpplugin"
    TARGET arp_script_plugin_scene3d
    LINK_LIBRARIES arp_scriptvm_runtime arp_scriptvm_ir arp_scriptvm_frontend arp_scriptvm_interpreter arp_scriptvm_aot_tooling arp_3d)
arp_add_script_plugin(
    MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/arp.resources_module.arpplugin"
    TARGET arp_script_plugin_resources
    REFLECTION_OWNER arp_resource
    LINK_LIBRARIES arp_resource arp_scriptvm_runtime arp_scriptvm_ir arp_scriptvm_frontend arp_scriptvm_interpreter arp_scriptvm_aot_tooling)
arp_add_script_plugin(
    MANIFEST "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/arp.network_module.arpplugin"
    TARGET arp_script_plugin_network
    REFLECTION_OWNER arp_network
    LINK_LIBRARIES arp_network arp_scriptvm_runtime arp_scriptvm_ir arp_scriptvm_frontend arp_scriptvm_interpreter arp_scriptvm_aot_tooling)

# Reflection codegen
set(ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_JSON
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/reflection/arp_network/network.reflection.json")
set(ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_CPP
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/reflection/arp_network/network.reflection.gen.cpp")
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_JSON}" "${ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_CPP}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/reflection/arp_network"
    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/reflect_codegen.py"
        --module network
        --out-json "${ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_JSON}"
        --out-cpp "${ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_CPP}"
        --header "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/network/network_module.h"
    DEPENDS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/reflect_codegen.py"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/modules/network/network_module.h"
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_target(arp_network_python_reflection_generated
    DEPENDS "${ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_JSON}" "${ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_CPP}")
add_dependencies(arp_network arp_network_python_reflection_generated)
target_sources(arp_network PRIVATE "${ARP_NETWORK_MODULE_REFLECTION_CPP}")

target_link_libraries(arp_rhi_bindless_package_tests PRIVATE arp_rhi_webgpu arp_rhi_metal arp_rhi arp_rhi_semantics arp_shader arp_render_graph)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
    # This Node-only CTest verifier reads the exact generated host fixture paths
    # supplied by CMake. Give it explicit host filesystem access; the browser
    # smoke runners retain their separately authored preload filesystems.
    target_link_options(arp_rhi_bindless_package_tests PRIVATE "-sNODERAWFS=1")
endif()
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten" AND Python3_EXECUTABLE AND SLANGC_EXECUTABLE)
    set(ARP_BINDLESS_WEBGPU_RHI_FIXTURE_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bindless-rhi-fixture")
    # Debug RHI recording has a deeper Asyncify continuation than the small
    # standalone shader runner; keep its stack budget explicit and bounded.
    set(ARP_BINDLESS_WEBGPU_RHI_ASYNCIFY_STACK_SIZE 16384)
    set(ARP_BINDLESS_WEBGPU_ROOT_PREPARATION_PUBLICATION
        "${ARP_BINDLESS_WEBGPU_RHI_FIXTURE_DIR}/original-root/MetalComputeBuffers.emulated.bindless.yaml")
    set(ARP_BINDLESS_WEBGPU_ROOT_GRAPHICS_PUBLICATIONS)

    # The retained finite-range fixture saves 24660 bytes at its first Debug
    # callback wait (measured from Asyncify's actual data header). Use the next
    # power-of-two bound for this fixture; unrelated runners keep their budget.
    set(ARP_BINDLESS_WEBGPU_ROOT_ASYNCIFY_STACK_SIZE 32768)
    # The production-layout skinning256 Root/readback/oracle path attempts
    # 91184 bytes of C++ stack (checked SP 0x7c300, original top 0x92730).
    # Bound this test target at the next power of two; retain runtime checks.
    # This is separate from Asyncify and all GPU/resource/owner budgets.
    set(ARP_BINDLESS_WEBGPU_ROOT_STACK_SIZE 131072)
    set_property(TARGET arp_rhi_webgpu_original_bindless_root_browser_smoke APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS

if(Python3_EXECUTABLE AND SLANGC_EXECUTABLE)
    get_filename_component(bindless_slang_tool_dir "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" DIRECTORY)
    find_program(ARP_BINDLESS_SPIRV_VAL_EXECUTABLE NAMES spirv-val
        HINTS "${bindless_slang_tool_dir}" DOC "SPIR-V validator for bindless compiler contracts")
    set(bindless_spirv_val_args)
    if(ARP_BINDLESS_SPIRV_VAL_EXECUTABLE)
        list(APPEND bindless_spirv_val_args --spirv-val "${ARP_BINDLESS_SPIRV_VAL_EXECUTABLE}")
    endif()
    if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
        # The runtime verifier is a Wasm module here and cannot be launched by
        # the host Python test process. Native presets run the package verifier.
        add_test(NAME arp_bindless_codegen_tests
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/bindless_codegen_tests.py"
                --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                ${bindless_spirv_val_args})
    else()
        add_test(NAME arp_bindless_codegen_tests
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/bindless_codegen_tests.py"
                --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                ${bindless_spirv_val_args}
                --runtime-verifier "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_rhi_bindless_package_tests>")
    endif()
endif()
if(Python3_EXECUTABLE AND SLANGC_EXECUTABLE AND SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE)
    set(ARP_SAMPLED_DEPTH_FIXTURE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bindless-sampled-depth-fixture")
    set(ARP_SAMPLED_DEPTH_PUBLICATIONS)
    foreach(depth_mode Native Emulated)
        string(TOLOWER "${depth_mode}" depth_mode_name)
        set(depth_publication "${ARP_SAMPLED_DEPTH_FIXTURE_DIR}/SampledDepth.${depth_mode_name}.bindless.yaml")
        list(APPEND ARP_SAMPLED_DEPTH_PUBLICATIONS "${depth_publication}")
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${depth_publication}"
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
                --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                --bindless-variant "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/bindless_sampled_depth.yaml"
                --bindless-source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/bindless_sampled_depth.slang"
                --bindless-entry cleanMain --bindless-entry faultMain --bindless-entry publicCleanMain --bindless-entry nativeSingleCellMain --bindless-mode "${depth_mode}"
                --out-dir "${ARP_SAMPLED_DEPTH_FIXTURE_DIR}"
            DEPENDS tests/fixtures/bindless_sampled_depth.yaml tests/fixtures/bindless_sampled_depth.slang
                scripts/bindless_codegen.py scripts/compile_shaders.py scripts/slang_resource_switch.py
                scripts/buffer_vector_record.py scripts/spirv_layout.py scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py
                "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            VERBATIM)
        add_test(NAME arp_rhi_bindless_sampled_depth_${depth_mode_name}_package_tests
            COMMAND arp_rhi_bindless_package_tests "${depth_publication}" valid sampled-depth)
    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(arp_bindless_sampled_depth_fixture DEPENDS ${ARP_SAMPLED_DEPTH_PUBLICATIONS})
    add_dependencies(arp_rhi_bindless_package_tests arp_bindless_sampled_depth_fixture)
    add_test(NAME arp_bindless_sampled_depth_compiler_contract_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/bindless_codegen_tests.py"
            BindlessCodegenTests.test_sampled_depth_integer_mip_schema_and_refusals
            BindlessCodegenTests.test_depth_integer_mip_lowering_preserves_color_and_nested_expressions)
    if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
        add_test(NAME arp_bindless_sampled_depth_resealed_package_tests
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/bindless_codegen_tests.py"
                --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                --runtime-verifier "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_rhi_bindless_package_tests>"
                BindlessCodegenTests.test_sampled_depth_cross_target_package_and_resealed_mismatch
                BindlessCodegenTests.test_sampled_depth_rejects_implicit_fractional_lod_and_invalidates_publication)
    endif()
    if(ARP_WEBGPU_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE)
        add_test(NAME arp_bindless_sampled_depth_browser_preflight
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/bindless_package_browser_preflight.py"
                --publication "${ARP_SAMPLED_DEPTH_FIXTURE_DIR}/SampledDepth.emulated.bindless.yaml"
                --browser "${ARP_WEBGPU_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE}"
                --output "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/artifacts/bindless-sampled-depth-preflight")
        set_tests_properties(arp_bindless_sampled_depth_browser_preflight PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 90)
    endif()
endif()
if(Python3_EXECUTABLE AND SLANGC_EXECUTABLE AND SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE)
    set(ARP_METAL_IMAGES_FIXTURE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bindless-metal-images-fixture")

                --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"

            DEPENDS tests/fixtures/bindless_metal_images.yaml tests/fixtures/bindless_metal_images.slang
                scripts/bindless_codegen.py scripts/buffer_vector_record.py scripts/slang_resource_switch.py scripts/compile_shaders.py scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py scripts/spirv_layout.py
                "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            VERBATIM)

    add_dependencies(arp_rhi_bindless_package_tests arp_bindless_metal_images_fixture)
    # Reuse the same Slang/uploaded-color workload as Vulkan's Root tests.
    set(ARP_COMPLETED_COLOR_FIXTURE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/bindless-completed-color-fixture")
    set(ARP_COMPLETED_COLOR_PUBLICATIONS)
    foreach(color_shape texture array)
        if(color_shape STREQUAL "texture")
            set(color_name CompletedTextureRoot)
            set(color_test color8)
        else()
            set(color_name CompletedArrayRoot)
            set(color_test array8)
        endif()
        set(color_publication "${ARP_COMPLETED_COLOR_FIXTURE_DIR}/${color_name}.native.bindless.yaml")
        list(APPEND ARP_COMPLETED_COLOR_PUBLICATIONS "${color_publication}")
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${color_publication}"
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
                --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                --bindless-variant "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/bindless_completed_${color_shape}_root.yaml"
                --bindless-source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/bindless_completed_${color_shape}_root.slang"
                --bindless-entry cleanMain --bindless-entry faultMain --bindless-mode Native
                --out-dir "${ARP_COMPLETED_COLOR_FIXTURE_DIR}"
            DEPENDS "tests/fixtures/bindless_completed_${color_shape}_root.yaml"
                "tests/fixtures/bindless_completed_${color_shape}_root.slang"
                scripts/bindless_codegen.py scripts/buffer_vector_record.py scripts/slang_resource_switch.py
                scripts/compile_shaders.py scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py scripts/spirv_layout.py
                "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            VERBATIM)

    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(arp_bindless_completed_color_fixture DEPENDS ${ARP_COMPLETED_COLOR_PUBLICATIONS})
    if(APPLE)
        add_executable(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests tests/integration/rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests.cpp)
        target_include_directories(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests PRIVATE . src)
        target_link_libraries(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests PRIVATE arp_rhi_metal)
        target_compile_options(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
        target_compile_definitions(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests PRIVATE
            ARP_METAL_IMAGES_PUBLICATION="${ARP_METAL_IMAGES_FIXTURE_DIR}/MetalComputeImages.native.bindless.yaml")
        add_dependencies(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests arp_bindless_metal_images_fixture)
        add_test(NAME arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests COMMAND arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests)
        set_tests_properties(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_images_tests PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 30 ENVIRONMENT "MTL_DEBUG_LAYER=1")

        # This assertion-enabled nested artifact/ownership fixture exceeded its
        # 16 KiB continuation stack (16596 bytes measured before stop_unwind).
        # Bound this test-runtime storage separately from all GPU/CPU quotas;
        # the browser runner records the peak across the complete fixture.
        target_link_options(arp_original_depth_table_expansion_artifact_tests PRIVATE
            -g2
            -sASYNCIFY -sASYNCIFY_STACK_SIZE=32768
            # Assertion-enabled Debug nested table/readback/source validation
            # exhausted the default 65536-byte C stack (SP -16). Reserve two
            # Wasm pages for this test harness; this is separate from Asyncify
            # storage and every original GPU/metadata quota.
            -sSTACK_SIZE=131072
            -sASSERTIONS=2 -sSTACK_OVERFLOW_CHECK=2
            "--preload-file=${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/original-depth-table-expansion@/original-depth-table-expansion"

if(Python3_EXECUTABLE AND SLANGC_EXECUTABLE AND SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE)
    set(original_depth_outputs)
    foreach(fixture descriptor_depth_compute descriptor_depth)
        set(fixture_dir "${ARP_ORIGINAL_DESCRIPTOR_DEPTH_FIXTURE_DIR}/${fixture}")
        set(fixture_outputs)
        foreach(role slang spv metal wgsl reflection.yaml)
            list(APPEND fixture_outputs "${fixture_dir}/${fixture}.${role}")
        endforeach()
        if(fixture STREQUAL "descriptor_depth_compute")
            set(fixture_entry_args --single-entry computeMain)
            list(APPEND fixture_outputs "${fixture_dir}/${fixture}.computeMain.entry.yaml")
        else()
            set(fixture_entry_args --graphics-module)
            list(APPEND fixture_outputs "${fixture_dir}/${fixture}.graphics.module.yaml")
            foreach(stage Vertex Fragment)
                foreach(role slang spv metal wgsl reflection.yaml)
                    list(APPEND fixture_outputs "${fixture_dir}/${stage}/${fixture}.${role}")
                endforeach()
            endforeach()
            list(APPEND fixture_outputs "${fixture_dir}/Vertex/${fixture}.vertexMain.entry.yaml"
                "${fixture_dir}/Fragment/${fixture}.fragmentMain.entry.yaml")
        endif()
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${fixture_outputs}
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
                --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                --fixture "${fixture}" ${fixture_entry_args} --out-dir "${fixture_dir}"
            DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/spirv_layout.py"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/${fixture}.slang"
                "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            VERBATIM)
        list(APPEND original_depth_outputs ${fixture_outputs})
    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(arp_original_descriptor_depth_fixture DEPENDS ${original_depth_outputs})
    add_dependencies(arp_original_descriptor_depth_artifacts_tests arp_original_descriptor_depth_fixture)
    if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
        add_test(NAME arp_original_descriptor_depth_artifacts_tests COMMAND arp_original_descriptor_depth_artifacts_tests
            "${ARP_ORIGINAL_DESCRIPTOR_DEPTH_FIXTURE_DIR}/descriptor_depth_compute/descriptor_depth_compute.computeMain.entry.yaml"
            "${ARP_ORIGINAL_DESCRIPTOR_DEPTH_FIXTURE_DIR}/descriptor_depth/descriptor_depth.graphics.module.yaml")
    endif()
endif()

    target_link_options(arp_rhi_webgpu_bindless_pipeline_browser_smoke PRIVATE

            foreach(role slang spv metal wgsl reflection.yaml)
                list(APPEND fixture_outputs "${fixture_dir}/${fixture}.${role}")
                foreach(stage Vertex Fragment)
                    list(APPEND fixture_outputs "${fixture_dir}/${stage}/${fixture}.${role}")
                endforeach()
            endforeach()
            list(APPEND fixture_outputs "${fixture_dir}/Vertex/${fixture}.vertexMain.entry.yaml"
                "${fixture_dir}/Fragment/${fixture}.fragmentMain.entry.yaml")
            add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${fixture_outputs}
                COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
                    --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                    --fixture "${fixture}" --graphics-module --out-dir "${fixture_dir}"
                DEPENDS scripts/compile_shaders.py scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py scripts/spirv_layout.py
                    "tests/fixtures/${fixture}.slang" "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                VERBATIM)
            list(APPEND target_memory_graphics_outputs ${fixture_outputs})
            add_test(NAME arp_original_target_${fixture}_memory_tests COMMAND arp_original_target_memory_tests --module
                "${fixture_dir}/${fixture}.graphics.module.yaml")
        endforeach()

        add_dependencies(arp_original_target_memory_tests arp_original_target_memory_graphics_fixture arp_graphics_shader_module_fixture)

            --push-module "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/target-memory-fixture/ordinary_graphics_push/ordinary_graphics_push.graphics.module.yaml"
            --uniform-module "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/target-memory-fixture/ordinary_graphics_uniform/ordinary_graphics_uniform.graphics.module.yaml")
        add_dependencies(arp_buffer_declaration_type_layout_tests arp_buffer_layout_probe_fixture)

if(TARGET arp_bindless_color_gi_fixture)
    set(graphics_color_gi_dir "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bindless-graphics-color-gi")
    set(graphics_color_gi_outputs)
    foreach(gi_mode Native Emulated)
        string(TOLOWER "${gi_mode}" gi_mode_name)
        set(gi_publication "${graphics_color_gi_dir}/GraphicsColorGi.${gi_mode_name}.bindless.yaml")
        list(APPEND graphics_color_gi_outputs "${gi_publication}")
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${gi_publication}"
            COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
                --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
                --bindless-variant "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/bindless_graphics_color_gi.yaml"
                --bindless-source "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/bindless_color_gi.slang"
                --bindless-entry vertexMain --bindless-entry cleanFragment --bindless-entry faultFragment
                --bindless-mode "${gi_mode}" --out-dir "${graphics_color_gi_dir}"
            DEPENDS tests/fixtures/bindless_graphics_color_gi.yaml tests/fixtures/bindless_color_gi.slang
                scripts/compile_shaders.py scripts/bindless_codegen.py scripts/slang_resource_switch.py
                scripts/buffer_vector_record.py scripts/spirv_layout.py scripts/shader_bindings_codegen.py
                "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            VERBATIM)
    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(arp_bindless_graphics_color_gi_fixture DEPENDS ${graphics_color_gi_outputs})
    add_test(NAME arp_bindless_graphics_color_gi_codegen_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/bindless_codegen_tests.py"
            --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --spirv-reflect "${SPIRV_REFLECT_EXECUTABLE}"
            ${bindless_spirv_val_args}
            BindlessCodegenTests.test_graphics_color_gi_stage_and_target_contract)
    if(APPLE AND TARGET arp_rhi_metal)
        add_executable(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_graphics_color_gi_tests
            tests/integration/rhi_metal_bindless_graphics_color_gi_tests.cpp
            tests/fixtures/metal_sampled_material_readback_fixture.mm)
        target_include_directories(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_graphics_color_gi_tests PRIVATE . src)
        target_link_libraries(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_graphics_color_gi_tests PRIVATE arp_rhi_metal)
        target_compile_options(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_graphics_color_gi_tests PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
        add_dependencies(arp_rhi_metal_bindless_graphics_color_gi_tests arp_bindless_graphics_color_gi_fixture)
        add_test(NAME arp_rhi_metal_bindless_graphics_color_gi_tests
            COMMAND arp_rhi_metal_bindless_graphics_color_gi_tests
                "${graphics_color_gi_dir}/GraphicsColorGi.native.bindless.yaml")

if(NOT APPLE AND NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
    set(ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/conformance-storage-program")
    set(ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}/conformance_storage_mrt.graphics.module.yaml")
    set(ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_SHADER_BYPRODUCTS)
    foreach(role slang spv metal wgsl reflection.yaml)
        list(APPEND ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_SHADER_BYPRODUCTS "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}/conformance_storage_mrt.${role}")
        foreach(stage Vertex Fragment)
            list(APPEND ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_SHADER_BYPRODUCTS "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}/${stage}/conformance_storage_mrt.${role}")
        endforeach()
    endforeach()
    list(APPEND ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_SHADER_BYPRODUCTS
        "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}/Vertex/conformance_storage_mrt.vertexMain.entry.yaml"
        "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}/Fragment/conformance_storage_mrt.fragmentMain.entry.yaml")
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE}"
        BYPRODUCTS ${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_SHADER_BYPRODUCTS}
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
            --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --fixture conformance_storage_mrt --graphics-module
            --out-dir "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}"
        DEPENDS scripts/compile_shaders.py tests/fixtures/conformance_storage_mrt.slang
        VERBATIM)
    set(ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}/Compute/conformance_storage_fill.computeMain.entry.yaml")
    set(ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE_BYPRODUCTS)
    foreach(role slang spv metal wgsl reflection.yaml)
        list(APPEND ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE_BYPRODUCTS "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}/Compute/conformance_storage_fill.${role}")
    endforeach()
    add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE}"
        BYPRODUCTS ${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE_BYPRODUCTS}
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/compile_shaders.py"
            --slangc "${SLANGC_EXECUTABLE}" --fixture conformance_storage_fill --single-entry computeMain
            --out-dir "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}/Compute"
        DEPENDS scripts/compile_shaders.py tests/fixtures/conformance_storage_fill.slang
        VERBATIM)
    add_custom_target(arp_conformance_storage_shader DEPENDS "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE}" "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE}")
    add_test(NAME arp_conformance_storage_mrt_shader_artifact_tests
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/contract/conformance_storage_mrt_artifact_test.py"
            --directory "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(arp_conformance_storage_mrt_shader_artifact_tests PROPERTIES LABELS "host-contract;shader;conformance")
    add_executable(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke
        tests/smoke/rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke.cpp src/platform/common/platform_lifecycle_state.cpp)
    target_include_directories(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke PRIVATE . src)
    target_link_libraries(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke PRIVATE arp_platform arp_render_graph arp_rhi arp_rhi_semantics)
    target_compile_options(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    arp_add_mingw_static_runtime(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke)
    add_dependencies(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke arp_conformance_storage_shader)
    foreach(mode IN ITEMS null vulkan)
        add_test(NAME arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_${mode}_smoke
            COMMAND arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke --${mode}
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/rhi_conformance_storage_mrt.yaml"
                "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE}" "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE}")
        set_tests_properties(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_${mode}_smoke PROPERTIES LABELS "conformance;${mode}-smoke" TIMEOUT 60)
    endforeach()
    set_tests_properties(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_vulkan_smoke PROPERTIES SKIP_RETURN_CODE 77)
    add_test(NAME arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_vulkan_original_output_smoke
        COMMAND arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke --vulkan-original
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/rhi_conformance_storage_mrt.yaml"
            "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE}" "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE}")
    set_tests_properties(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_vulkan_original_output_smoke
        PROPERTIES LABELS "conformance;original-output;vulkan-native" TIMEOUT 60)
    add_test(NAME arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_vulkan_original_negative_smoke
        COMMAND arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke --vulkan-original-negative
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/rhi_conformance_storage_mrt.yaml"
            "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_MODULE}" "${ARP_CONFORMANCE_STORAGE_COMPUTE}")
    set_tests_properties(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_vulkan_original_negative_smoke
        PROPERTIES LABELS "conformance;original-output;vulkan-native" TIMEOUT 60)
    if(WIN32 AND EXISTS "C:/Program Files/RenderDoc/renderdoc_app.h")
        target_include_directories(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke PRIVATE "C:/Program Files/RenderDoc")
        target_compile_definitions(arp_rhi_conformance_storage_mrt_smoke PRIVATE ARP_RENDERDOC_APP_AVAILABLE=1)
    endif()

        --tool "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_vegetation_catalog_cooked_tests>" --workspace "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
        --terrain-tool "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_terrain_asset_tool>" --authoring --spatial-weights
        --reader "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_terrain_vegetation_binding_tests>")
    set_tests_properties(arp_terrain_vegetation_cli_session_smoke PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 120)
    add_test(NAME arp_terrain_scene_session_smoke
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/tooling/terrain_asset_cli_smoke.py"
        --tool "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_terrain_asset_tool>" --reader "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_terrain_scene_session_tests>"
        --authoring "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/terrain/constant.terrain.yaml"
        --workspace "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(arp_terrain_scene_session_smoke PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 90)
    add_test(NAME arp_terrain_physics_scene_smoke
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/tooling/terrain_asset_cli_smoke.py"
        --tool "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_terrain_asset_tool>" --reader "$<TARGET_FILE:arp_terrain_physics_binding_tests>"

        --workspace "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(arp_terrain_physics_scene_smoke PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 90)
endif()

add_executable(arp_ddgi_recording_tests tests/integration/ddgi_recording_tests.cpp)
target_include_directories(arp_ddgi_recording_tests PRIVATE . src "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
# The renderer closure resolves rhi_semantics before rhi (declared
# direction rhi_semantics->rhi), but null_backend inside the rhi archive
# references semantics symbols; GNU ld needs semantics after rhi.
target_link_libraries(arp_ddgi_recording_tests PRIVATE arp_renderer arp_rhi arp_rhi_semantics)
target_compile_definitions(arp_ddgi_recording_tests PRIVATE ARP_SHADER_DIR="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
arp_add_mingw_static_runtime(arp_ddgi_recording_tests)
add_executable(arp_ddgi_bvh_ownership_tests tests/integration/ddgi_bvh_ownership_tests.cpp)
target_include_directories(arp_ddgi_bvh_ownership_tests PRIVATE . src "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
target_link_libraries(arp_ddgi_bvh_ownership_tests PRIVATE arp_renderer arp_rhi arp_rhi_semantics)
target_compile_definitions(arp_ddgi_bvh_ownership_tests PRIVATE ARP_SHADER_DIR="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
arp_add_mingw_static_runtime(arp_ddgi_bvh_ownership_tests)
add_executable(arp_ddgi_uniform_ownership_tests tests/integration/ddgi_uniform_ownership_tests.cpp)
target_include_directories(arp_ddgi_uniform_ownership_tests PRIVATE . src "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
target_link_libraries(arp_ddgi_uniform_ownership_tests PRIVATE arp_renderer arp_rhi arp_rhi_semantics)
target_compile_definitions(arp_ddgi_uniform_ownership_tests PRIVATE ARP_SHADER_DIR="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
arp_add_mingw_static_runtime(arp_ddgi_uniform_ownership_tests)
add_executable(arp_ddgi_descriptor_recovery_tests tests/integration/ddgi_descriptor_recovery_tests.cpp)
target_include_directories(arp_ddgi_descriptor_recovery_tests PRIVATE . src "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
target_link_libraries(arp_ddgi_descriptor_recovery_tests PRIVATE arp_renderer arp_rhi arp_rhi_semantics)
target_compile_definitions(arp_ddgi_descriptor_recovery_tests PRIVATE ARP_SHADER_DIR="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
arp_add_mingw_static_runtime(arp_ddgi_descriptor_recovery_tests)
foreach(_ddgi_contract IN ITEMS arp_ddgi_recording_tests arp_ddgi_bvh_ownership_tests arp_ddgi_uniform_ownership_tests arp_ddgi_descriptor_recovery_tests arp_renderer_data_model_tests)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${_ddgi_contract} PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${_ddgi_contract} PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    endif()
endforeach()

    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fixtures/aot/stress.arp")

    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/script-bench/stress_corpus_source.h" @ONLY)

    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/script-bench")

if(NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Emscripten")
    # These tests load a C++ plugin through arp_engine.dll. Linking the test
    # executable to the same DLL keeps reflection, allocator, and plugin ABI
    # state in one process-wide engine instance.
    add_executable(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_tests
        tests/unit/scriptvm_cpp_plugin_tests.cpp)
    target_include_directories(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_tests PRIVATE . src)
    target_link_libraries(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_tests PRIVATE arp_engine)
    add_dependencies(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_tests arp_engine arp_reflect_codegen)
    target_compile_definitions(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_tests PRIVATE
        ARP_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
        ARP_TEST_CXX_COMPILER="${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}"
        ARP_TEST_HOST_LIBRARY="$<TARGET_FILE:arp_engine>"
        ARP_TEST_REFLECTION_CODEGEN="$<TARGET_FILE:arp_reflect_codegen>"
        ARP_CPP_PLUGIN_DIFFERENTIAL_TEST=$<IF:$<BOOL:${ARP_SCRIPT_AOT_ONLY_RELEASE}>,0,1>)
    add_executable(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_smoke
        tests/smoke/scriptvm_cpp_plugin_smoke.cpp)
    target_include_directories(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_smoke PRIVATE . src)
    target_link_libraries(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_smoke PRIVATE arp_engine)
    add_dependencies(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_smoke arp_engine arp_reflect_codegen)
    target_compile_definitions(arp_scriptvm_cpp_plugin_smoke PRIVATE
        ARP_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
        ARP_TEST_CXX_COMPILER="${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}"
        ARP_TEST_HOST_LIBRARY="$<TARGET_FILE:arp_engine>"
        ARP_TEST_REFLECTION_CODEGEN="$<TARGET_FILE:arp_reflect_codegen>")
endif()

# UI Control Events/1: assertion-enabled fast contract and headless smoke.
foreach(ui_event_test IN ITEMS ui_control_object_contract_tests ui_control_object_smoke)
    add_executable(arp_${ui_event_test} tests/contract/${ui_event_test}.cpp)
    target_include_directories(arp_${ui_event_test} PRIVATE src)
    target_link_libraries(arp_${ui_event_test} PRIVATE arp_ui_runtime)
    target_compile_options(arp_${ui_event_test} PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    add_test(NAME arp_${ui_event_test} COMMAND arp_${ui_event_test})
endforeach()

target_compile_options(arp_ui_control_factory_lifecycle_tests PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
add_test(NAME arp_ui_control_factory_lifecycle_tests COMMAND arp_ui_control_factory_lifecycle_tests)

# Existing UI contracts were source-only; keep migration regressions executable.
foreach(ui_migration_test IN ITEMS ui_typed_controls_contract ui_public_surface_contract ui_runtime_tree_contract ui_runtime_boundary_contract ui_unified_atlas_boundary_contract ui_framework_completeness_contract ui_document_contract ui_arpui_game_screen_contract ui_control_runtime ui_interaction_runtime ui_arpui_runtime_load ui_arpui_resource_package ui_document_resource ui_layout_style_theme ui_renderer_integration scene_ui_runtime scene_input_controller gui_control_builder imgui_extension)
    if(ui_migration_test MATCHES "_contract$")
        set(ui_migration_source tests/contract/${ui_migration_test}_tests.cpp)
    else()
        set(ui_migration_source tests/integration/${ui_migration_test}_tests.cpp)
    endif()
    if(NOT TARGET arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${ui_migration_source}")
        add_executable(arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests ${ui_migration_source})
        target_include_directories(arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests PRIVATE . src)
        target_compile_definitions(arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests PRIVATE ARP_SOURCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
        target_compile_options(arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
        target_link_libraries(arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests PRIVATE arp_gui arp_ui_runtime arp_resource arp_scriptvm_host_plugin_runtime)
        add_test(NAME arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests COMMAND arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests)
        set_tests_properties(arp_${ui_migration_test}_tests PROPERTIES WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
    endif()
endforeach()
